content: I'm wondering if people might have tips for making projects that depend on Mathlib more resilient to changes introduced by new Mathlib and Lean versions? I know that using the output to simp? is one. Are there others?

A (dual) tip to have a better time with breaking changes when bumping mathlib is to use hopscotch to bisect failures, or even consider onboarding your project to downstream-reports if it's an actively maintained project.
Another small one: follow the deprecation warnings that you get already. Very soon (once you upgrade to the coming Lean release candidate?), these will come with try this: suggestions.
